project_inclusion.range_basis: Texas-native in Rolling Plains seep and river-bottom habitats, but no project target-zone native counties verified; preserve FAIL_TARGET_ZONE.

look_here_first: Inspect white-tomentose stems and broad opposite leaves; then large rose-purple umbels and the conspicuously star-like individual flowers, hoods and horns.

best_field_traits: tall stout perennial with white-tomentose shoots
large rose-purple umbels with spreading petals and conspicuous hoods/horns

comparisons.key_distinctions: A. syriaca has similarly broad opposite leaves, but generally denser rounder umbels and less star-like individual flowers; confirm with corona close-up. A. incarnata has narrower leaves and wet-site habit.
